description: This PHP source file defines the 'MenuDao' class responsible for data access operations related to menu items within an HRM system. It includes methods for enabling/disabling menu items, retrieving menu items by various criteria, and managing menu hierarchies and permissions, interacting with entities like MenuItem, Module, UserRole, and utilizing an ORM query builder.

classes.name: MenuDao
classes.description: Data access object class for performing CRUD and complex query operations on menu items within the system, including enabling/disabling modules, retrieving menu hierarchy, and applying permission filters.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items associated with a specific module and optionally filtered by menu titles.

methods.name: updateStatusOfModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Updates the status (enable/disable) of menu items based on module name and optional menu titles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item corresponding to a specific module and screen URL.

methods.name: getSidePanelMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches top-level menu items accessible to a set of user roles for side panel display.

methods.name: getTopMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves second-level menu items under a specified side menu item, along with their nested children, for a set of user roles.

methods.name: getMenuItemQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query wrapper to fetch menu items based on user role permissions and module status.

methods.name: getMenuItemByTitle
methods.description: Fetches a menu item based on its title and optional menu level.

methods.name: getModuleByName
methods.description: Retrieves module entity by its name.
